verdict.rationale: CIPO publishes downloadable bulk data (IP Horizons, the Canadian IP databases page) and lets users download patent office records and retrieve trademark documents. That means much of a user's filing data, which is public record, can be extracted. However, nothing in the evidence describes an account-level export of a user's own MyCIPO data, and no item says which formats the bulk data uses. Missing for 10: self-service export of all account data (MyCIPO correspondence and filings), documented open or machine-readable formats, and independent or hands-on corroboration of export completeness.
